<description>
[quoted text omitted]

This reduces the size of bitcoind by ~`0.5mb`, and bitcoin-qt by `1.3mb` (`aarch64-apple-darwin`).

This option exists for lld, which is why it's only added for darwin builds.
</description>

<commits>
ee9f7dbf5f build: add -Wl,--icf=safe(thunks)

[quoted text omitted]
This reduces the size of (release) bitcoind by ~0.5mb, and bitcoin-qt
by 1.3mb (aarch64-apple-darwin).
</commits>

<files>
CMakeLists.txt  +4/-0

(test/bench/ci lines: 0)

<patch>
diff --git a/CMakeLists.txt b/CMakeLists.txt
index 26df532af2..729bb447c2 100644
--- a/CMakeLists.txt
+++ b/CMakeLists.txt
@@ -600,6 +600,10 @@ if(REDUCE_EXPORTS)
   try_append_linker_flag("-Wl,-no_exported_symbols" VAR CMAKE_EXE_LINKER_FLAGS)
 endif()
 
+# Attempt to use safe identical code folding. This reduces binary size.
+try_append_linker_flag("-faddrsig -Wl,--icf=safe" VAR CMAKE_EXE_LINKER_FLAGS)
+try_append_linker_flag("-faddrsig -Wl,--icf=safe_thunks" VAR CMAKE_EXE_LINKER_FLAGS)
+
 # Prefer Unix-style package components over frameworks on macOS.
 # This improves compatibility with Python version managers.
 set(Python3_FIND_FRAMEWORK LAST CACHE STRING "")

</patch>
(Diff from merge base to head, smallest files first.)
